name: list_files
description: List one directory of your worktree (not recursive), sorted; a directory ends in /, a link in @. Names are shown escaped (\n, \t, \\ and \xNN for other control or non-UTF-8 bytes). Example: {"path":"src"}

path.description: Directory relative to the worktree root; leave out for the root

repo.description: The slot to list in; leave out when there is one
